title: Rann of Kutch
tagline: Where the earth meets the sky

heroImage.alt: Endless white expanse of the Great Rann of Kutch glowing under sunset colors

overview.short: Infinite white salt flats, flamingos, full moon nights and the Rann Utsav festival.
overview.description: The Great Rann of Kutch is the world's largest salt desert — a vast, blinding white expanse that stretches to the horizon. The annual Rann Utsav (Nov–Feb) transforms this remote region with cultural celebrations, folk music and tent city accommodation.

routes.byAir: AMD Airport + 6hr drive or fly to Bhuj (BHJ)

howToReach.roadNote: Bhuj is the base for Rann exploration. Roads are good from Bhuj to Dhordo. Book Rann Utsav well in advance.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Rann of Kutch?
faq.a: The best time to visit Rann of Kutch is Nov – Feb (during Rann Utsav). Summers are 25–48°C and winters are 10–30°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Rann of Kutch?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Bhuj Airport (BHJ) (85 km) and the nearest railway station is Bhuj Railway Station (85 km). Bhuj is the base for Rann exploration. Roads are good from Bhuj to Dhordo. Book Rann Utsav well in advance.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Rann of Kutch?
faq.a: 4 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Rann of Kutch at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Rann of Kutch?
faq.a: Stays in Rann of Kutch start from ₹600 per night, with options across 7 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Rann of Kutch?
faq.a: The top attractions are White Rann Sunset Point, Rann Utsav Tent City, Dholavira, Kalo Dungar (Black Hills), Flamingo City, Little Rann.
